name: What a Kirkland Refinishing Deposit Should and Shouldn't Cover
title-tag: What a Refinishing Deposit Should Cover — Kirkland, WA
meta-description: How big should a floor refinishing deposit be? A Kirkland-area contractor on the fair 10–30% range, what deposits should cover, and the red flags to walk from.
post-summary: December 28, 2026 · A deposit should hold your dates and cover job-specific materials — roughly 10–30% against a written quote — and nothing more. How to read a deposit request like a contractor, the payment structure that keeps your leverage at the walk-through, and the red flags that mean keep shopping.
